lines.text: Every Saturday starts the same way. Tabs open everywhere, and still nowhere to go.
FamHop does the looking for you. Your weekend, already planned.
A real day, start to finish. Three stops, a few blocks apart.
Wrong day for your kid? Change it, and the plan rebuilds.
Every park, museum and library near you, already on the map.
Sixteen metros. And the events are refreshed every week.
Or let us send five ideas, every Friday.

bgm.query: warm unhurried indie-acoustic underscore, light percussion, one gentle lift into the close
bgm.blob: Planning your family's weekend shouldn't take 47 tabs
bgm.arc: PAS — Pain (tab overwhelm) → Agitation (still no plan) → Solution (one card) → Proof (plan, tuning, coverage) → CTA
